description: This file implements platform-specific event handling functions for the lighttpd web server, including initialization, configuration, and polling mechanisms for different OS-specific event notification systems such as epoll, kqueue, port, devpoll, poll, and select.

methods.name: fdevent_config
methods.description: Configures the event handler based on system capabilities and user override.

methods.name: fdevent_show_event_handlers
methods.description: Returns a string listing available event handlers.

methods.name: fdevent_init
methods.description: Initializes the event handling system with the selected event handler.

methods.name: fdevent_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the event handling system.

methods.name: fdevent_reset
methods.description: Resets the event system, typically after a fork.

methods.name: fdevent_poll
methods.description: Polls for events with a specified timeout.
